description: Searches the US eCFR by keyword or retrieves the current text of a specific section (title, part, section) via the official eCFR API. Returns hierarchy, heading, text (max 50,000 characters), last amended date, and official URL. Coverage: current CFR as published on ecfr.gov. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

part.description: CFR part number (e.g. 1020) for section lookup

section.description: CFR section number (e.g. 1020.210) for section lookup

title.description: CFR title number (1–50) for section lookup
